snippet.title: MASUKU Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Demo out now 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/44...

Description:
MASUKU is an abstract puzzle game for up to 4 players where you must place holes with holes in them on a grid to score points. With ever changing scoring conditions. 
The full game will release later in the year. For now we are releasing a demo containing the daily challenge. 

Daily Challenge:
Come back every day to compete for the top spot on the leaderboard. Get 50 points in the fewest turns. The challenge is the same for everyone that day and u can retry as many times as you want, to try to optimise your strategy now you know what cards will be coming in future turns. 

Accessibility features:
Light and dark modes
Text to speech via Lowtek Games’ Dislectek plugin
Customisable colors for colorblind players

History:
The game started out life as a global game jam entry 2026. The theme was mask and was initially prototyped with paper cut out cards. The idea was to mask out the colors and shapes to score points with a changing rule set a bit like the card game flux. Then when designing Ally decided to play a version inside of Adobe illustrator and thought it could work as a digital game so pivoted during the jam to build in unity. 
The name MASUKU is from the Japanese word for mask.
